reason: H0 exclusively exercises JSON decoding through wuffs_json__decoder__decode_tokens and wuffs_aux::DecodeJson, while S1 changes the XZ decoding path that validates SHA-256 block checksums using wuffs_base__bitvec256__get_u64. Therefore H0 cannot exercise XZ stream parsing, coroutine suspension/resumption, checksum-algorithm selection, or the four 64-bit SHA-256 comparisons in wuffs_xz__decoder__do_transform_io.
evidence: H0 enables WUFFS_CONFIG__MODULE__JSON and calls wuffs_json__decoder__decode_tokens; it does not enable or invoke the XZ, LZMA, CRC64, or SHA256 decoder paths.

S1 changes wuffs_xz__decoder__do_transform_io at four comparisons of checksum256_have against checksum64_want, replacing wuffs_base__bitvec256__get with wuffs_base__bitvec256__get_u64 for indices 3u, 2u, 1u, and 0u.
The affected branch is selected when self->private_impl.f_checksummer == 3u, derived from the XZ stream flags identifying SHA-256.
wuffs_xz__decoder__do_transform_io contains multiple short-read and transform_io suspension points, but H0's fragmentation and no-progress checks apply only to wuffs_json__decoder.
recommended_action: Add a dedicated XZ decoder fuzz harness invoking wuffs_xz__decoder__transform_io with varied source and destination chunk sizes. Include valid and malformed XZ streams covering checksummer values 0, 1, 2, and especially 3, with truncated or mismatched SHA-256 words at all four get_u64 indices, and exercise repeated short-read and short-write resumptions.
